description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller class 'ProductController' responsible for managing product-related operations in an e-commerce administration backend. It handles creating, editing, duplicating, and deleting products, as well as managing product images and category associations.

classes.name: ProductController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling product management operations such as create, edit, duplicate, delete images, and manage category associations within an e-commerce system.

methods.name: displayProductEdit
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the product edit page with pre-filled product data if editing an existing product.

methods.name: displayProductCreate
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the product creation page with empty product data.

methods.name: displayProduct
methods.description: Shared private method to prepare model attributes for product creation/edit pages.

methods.name: saveProduct
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update a product, including image validation and processing.

methods.name: duplicateProduct
methods.description: Handles POST request to duplicate an existing product, creating a copy with nested properties but excluding SKU, images, and reviews.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete a product image given its ID, returning JSON response.

methods.name: displayAddProductToCategories
methods.description: Displays page to add a product to categories.

methods.name: pageProductCategories
methods.description: Returns JSON with list of categories associated with a given product, for pagination.

methods.name: deleteProductFromCategory
methods.description: Removes association between a product and a category via POST request.

methods.name: addProductToCategory
methods.description: Associates a product with a category via POST request.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets active menu context for views.
